name: signalapp/libsignal
description: The Signal Protocol implementation including Double Ratchet algorithm, zero-knowledge group cryptography, and other cryptographic primitives powering the Signal messaging app. Exposed as Java, Swift, and TypeScript libraries over Rust implementations.
score_rationale: Production-grade cryptographic protocol library from Signal with 5.6k stars, actively maintained through March 2026, representing best-in-class secure messaging cryptography.
